title: They Could Have Bought Netflix for $50 Million #shorts
description:
In two thousand, Netflix's founders offered to sell their company to Blockbuster for fifty million dollars. Blockbuster said no. Ten years later it was bankrupt.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
hook_text:
NETFLIX FOR $50 MILLION
THEY SAID NO
first_comment: Biggest business mistake ever, or would you have said no too? 👇

lines.text: Blockbuster could have bought Netflix for fifty million dollars.
In two thousand, Blockbuster ruled movie rentals, with thousands of stores.
Netflix was a tiny company mailing DVDs, and losing money.
Its founders offered to sell for fifty million dollars.
Then streaming arrived, and customers stopped coming to the store.
In twenty ten, Blockbuster filed for bankruptcy.
Netflix is now worth hundreds of billions.
All because of one fifty million dollar no.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
